qMetaDef.title: Sales
qMetaDef.description: Invoiced revenue in EUR in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount
qMetaDef.description: Sales minus the cost of the goods sold, in EUR in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount as a percentage of Sales in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake
qMetaDef.description: Value of new orders booked, in EUR in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Budget
qMetaDef.description: Planned Sales in EUR, whole months in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment
qMetaDef.description: Sales as a percentage of Budget in the current selection.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD
qMetaDef.description: Sales from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount YTD
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales), '0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin YTD
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin (percentage of Sales) from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake YTD
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Budget YTD
qMetaDef.description: Budget from 1 January through the Latest Date, each month's Budget spread evenly over its days.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment YTD
qMetaDef.description: Sales as a percentage of Budget from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales for the same days one year earlier than YTD.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount YTD Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Cost)) / 1e9, '€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount for the same days one year earlier than YTD.

qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales), '0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin (percentage of Sales) for the same days one year earlier than YTD.

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake for the same days one year earlier than YTD.

qMetaDef.title: Budget YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Budget for the same days one year earlier than YTD, each month's Budget spread evenly over its days.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment YTD Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales as a percentage of Budget for the same days one year earlier than YTD.

qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales)) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD minus Sales YTD Prior Year.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Sales YTD against Sales YTD Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD vs Budget
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD minus Budget YTD.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD vs Budget %
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD against Budget YTD, as a percentage above or below it.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost) - (Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Cost))) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount YTD minus Gross Margin Amount YTD Prior Year.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Prior Year %
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost)) / (Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Cost)) - 1, '+0.0%;-0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Gross Margin Amount YTD against YTD Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin YTD vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num(((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - (Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales)) * 100, '+0.0 pp;-0.0 pp')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin YTD minus Gross Margin YTD Prior Year, in percentage points.

qMeasure.qLabel: Order Intake YTD vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} [Order Intake]) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} [Order Intake])) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake YTD minus Order Intake YTD Prior Year.

qMeasure.qLabel: Order Intake YTD vs Prior Year %

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake YTD vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Order Intake YTD against YTD Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMeasure.qLabel: Budget Attainment YTD vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: If($(vBudgetDefined), Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) / $(vBudget($(vYTDFirstDay), $(vLastDay))) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) / $(vBudget($(vYTDPriorYearFirstDay), $(vPriorYearLastDay)))) * 100, '+0.0 pp;-0.0 pp'))

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Budget Attainment YTD minus Budget Attainment YTD Prior Year, in percentage points.

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Sales for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Cost)) / 1e9, '€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales), '0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin (percentage of Sales) for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Budget for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date, each month's Budget spread evenly over its days.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months
qMetaDef.description: Sales as a percentage of Budget for the 12 months ending on the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Cost)) / 1e9, '€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales), '0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin (percentage of Sales) for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qLabel: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months Prior Year

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Budget Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Budget for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date, each month's Budget spread evenly over its days.

qMeasure.qLabel: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months Prior Year

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales as a percentage of Budget for the 12 months ending one year before the Latest Date.

qMeasure.qLabel: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales)) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Sales Rolling 12 Months minus Sales Rolling 12 Months Prior Year.

qMeasure.qLabel: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Sales Rolling 12 Months against Sales Rolling 12 Months Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Budget
qMetaDef.description: Sales Rolling 12 Months minus Budget Rolling 12 Months.

qMetaDef.title: Sales Rolling 12 Months vs Budget %
qMetaDef.description: Sales Rolling 12 Months against Budget Rolling 12 Months, as a percentage above or below it.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Cost) - (Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Cost))) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months minus Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months Prior Year.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Cost)) / (Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Cost)) - 1, '+0.0%;-0.0%')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Gross Margin Amount Rolling 12 Months against Rolling 12 Months Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num(((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) - (Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales)) * 100, '+0.0 pp;-0.0 pp')

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months minus Gross Margin Rolling 12 Months Prior Year, in percentage points.

qMeasure.qLabel: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} [Order Intake]) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} [Order Intake])) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months minus Order Intake Rolling 12 Months Prior Year.

qMeasure.qLabel: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %

qMetaDef.title: Order Intake Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Order Intake Rolling 12 Months against Rolling 12 Months Prior Year, as a percentage.

qMeasure.qLabel: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: If($(vBudgetDefined), Num((Sum({<$(vRolling12Months)>} Sales) / $(vBudget($(vRolling12MonthsFirstDay), $(vLastDay))) - Sum({<$(vRolling12MonthsPriorYear)>} Sales) / $(vBudget($(vRolling12MonthsPriorYearFirstDay), $(vPriorYearLastDay)))) * 100, '+0.0 pp;-0.0 pp'))

qMetaDef.title: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months minus Budget Attainment Rolling 12 Months Prior Year, in percentage points.

qMetaDef.title: Customer Share
qMetaDef.description: A Customer's Sales YTD as a share of the Sales YTD of all Customers in the selection.

qMeasure.qDef: If(Dimensionality() > 0, Num(Sum(TOTAL <Customer> Aggr(RangeSum(Above(Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales), 0, RowNo())), (Customer, (=Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales), Descending)))) / Sum({<$(vYTD)>} TOTAL Sales), '0.0%'))

qMetaDef.title: Customer Cumulative Share
qMetaDef.description: In a chart by Customer: the Customer's share of Sales YTD plus that of every Customer with larger Sales YTD, whatever order the chart shows them in. Null outside a chart.

qMeasure.qDef: If(Dimensionality() > 0, If([Customer Cumulative Share] <= 0.8, Dual('A', 1), If([Customer Cumulative Share] <= 0.95, Dual('B', 2), Dual('C', 3))))

qMetaDef.title: Customer ABC Class
qMetaDef.description: In a chart by Customer sorted by Sales YTD, largest first: A while the cumulative share is up to 80%, B up to 95%, C the rest (a dual: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3). Null outside a chart.

qMeasure.qLabel: Volume Effect YTD vs Prior Year

qMetaDef.title: Volume Effect YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: The part of Sales YTD vs Prior Year due to the change in Volume, at the Prior Year average price (Product Line by Customer). See docs/measures.md, Sales Bridge.

qMeasure.qLabel: Price Effect YTD vs Prior Year

qMetaDef.title: Price Effect YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: The part of Sales YTD vs Prior Year due to the change in price within each Product Line by Customer. See docs/measures.md, Sales Bridge.

qMeasure.qLabel: Mix Effect YTD vs Prior Year
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - $(vVolumeEffectYTD) - $(vPriceEffectYTD)) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Mix Effect YTD vs Prior Year
qMetaDef.description: The part of Sales YTD vs Prior Year due to the change in the Product Line by Customer shares of Volume: Sales YTD vs Prior Year minus the Volume and Price Effects, so the three sum exactly. See docs/measures.md, Sales Bridge.

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Sales YTD
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD under the What-If scenario: price and volume changes applied, Sales outside the euro area translated at the changed EUR exchange rate.

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Sales YTD vs Actual
qMetaDef.description: Simulated Sales YTD minus Sales YTD.

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Sales YTD vs Actual %
qMetaDef.description: Change of Simulated Sales YTD against Sales YTD, as a percentage.

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Gross Margin Amount YTD
qMetaDef.description: Simulated Sales YTD minus the simulated cost YTD (cost moves with volume and, for its local share outside the euro area, with the exchange rate; not with price).

qMeasure.qLabel: Simulated Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Actual
qMeasure.qDef: Num((($(vSimulatedSalesYTD)) - ($(vSimulatedCostYTD)) - (Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost))) / 1e9, '+€#,##0.00 bn;-€#,##0.00 bn')

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Gross Margin Amount YTD vs Actual
qMetaDef.description: Simulated Gross Margin Amount YTD minus Gross Margin Amount YTD.

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Gross Margin YTD
qMetaDef.description: Simulated Gross Margin Amount YTD as a percentage of Simulated Sales YTD.

qMeasure.qLabel: Simulated Gross Margin YTD vs Actual
qMeasure.qDef: Num(((($(vSimulatedSalesYTD)) - ($(vSimulatedCostYTD))) / ($(vSimulatedSalesYTD)) - (Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Cost)) / Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales)) * 100, '+0.0 pp;-0.0 pp')

qMetaDef.title: Simulated Gross Margin YTD vs Actual
qMetaDef.description: Simulated Gross Margin YTD minus Gross Margin YTD, in percentage points.

qMetaDef.title: Book-to-bill YTD
qMetaDef.description: Order Intake YTD divided by Sales YTD: above 1 means more was ordered than invoiced from 1 January through the Latest Date.

qMetaDef.title: Sales in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Sales in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMeasure.qLabel: Sales YTD Prior Year in EUR m

qMetaDef.title: Sales YTD Prior Year in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Sales YTD Prior Year in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMeasure.qLabel: Gross Margin Amount YTD in EUR m

qMetaDef.title: Gross Margin Amount YTD in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Gross Margin Amount YTD in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMeasure.qLabel: Volume Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m

qMetaDef.title: Volume Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Volume Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMeasure.qLabel: Price Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m

qMetaDef.title: Price Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Price Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.

qMeasure.qLabel: Mix Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m
qMeasure.qDef: Num((Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) - $(vVolumeEffectYTD) - $(vPriceEffectYTD)) / 1e6, '+€#,##0.0 m;-€#,##0.0 m')

qMetaDef.title: Mix Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m
qMetaDef.description: Mix Effect YTD vs Prior Year in EUR m instead of EUR bn, for small amounts.
